build_steps.description: Use Node.js 20.x on Debian Bookworm as base image
Prevent interactive prompts during apt-get operations
Install system packages for native module compilation and headless browser testing
Create benchmark directory for build scripts
Copy repository setup script from build context
Execute repo_setup.sh to clone Babylon.js repository at specific commit and prepare /workspace
Copy runtime setup script from build context
Execute setup_runtime.sh to install Node.js 20.18.0, npm dependencies, and ts-patch
Set working directory to /workspace for test execution

verifier_assets.note: Verifier assets are NOT baked into the image - they are runtime-mounted

assets.purpose: Test runner script that executes Jest tests
External Jest configuration for running tests
Hidden test file for WGSL shader fixes verification

repo_materialization.method: git shallow clone with partial fetch
